environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod but with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotation `container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/processor: localhost/k8s-stream-processor-restrict`. The profile (compiled from /etc/apparmor.d/k8s-stream-processor-restrict) denies exec transitions for all paths except /usr/local/bin/processor (the main binary), denies write to all paths except /var/lib/processor/output/** and /tmp/**, and denies read access to /proc/*/maps, /etc/shadow, and /etc/passwd. The profile uses `deny /** x,` as a base with explicit `allow /usr/local/bin/processor ix,` override. Network access is unrestricted in the profile. Additionally, the container runs with `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` and `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false` in the pod security context.
